zh:
对于陈途返乡这件事，乡里众人起初难以理解。
在他们看来，陈途当年费了那么大的功夫，才考学考到墨城去。又何必兜兜转转，到头来，往家乡这穷地方钻。
“途娃，你好不容易才考学考出去，你糊涂啊！”当年资助了陈途三个鸡蛋考学的林幺爹痛心疾首。
“途哥儿，听说那墨城繁华得很，你当真不想留下来？”正忙着犁田的张娃深是遗憾。
还有的仗义执言，声称若是陈途在城里受了欺负，他们便是拼了命，也要叫欺负陈途的人好看！
可这些猜测都不对，但愈是这样，村里的流言便愈不止。
似那一束接着一束往灶里添的薪材，将家乡这锅原本平静的水，煮沸煮开。
而那个陈途要把乡里建成桃源的消息，更是往锅里扔了一块石头，把这锅沸水溅得到处都是。
“桃源不应该是在天上嘛，咱们这穷山恶水，哪有什么桃源……”
“途娃哟，你脑子是不是不大舒服，没事儿，你叔我这就带你找大夫看看……”
陈途这下真的头疼了，但他也不是没解释，可村子里的人不懂得机巧，也难以解释得明白。
索性便自顾地从自家做起，拿出安世师弟曾画给过他的水利图纸——
一步步挖土、填土，哪怕效仿的是精卫填海。
村里的乡亲们看在眼里，只觉着陈途看上去疯得更加厉害。
一天、两天、一月、两月，陈途一个人，一把铁锨，堪堪挖出一条道儿来。
但图纸里的工事，还有许多条道儿要挖。他揉了揉酸疼的肩膀，心里难免地生出一丝望洋兴叹。
“到底是从城里回来的，你起开。”忽地，有人从旁边夺过他手中的铁锨。陈途抬头一望，张娃正杵着铁锨的杆儿，老神在在。
“往哪边？”
“什么哪边？”
“就是你说的那劳什子水利图纸，挖土往哪边？”
陈途回过神来，连忙指了个方向。他朝着那个方向望去，村子里的众人正也朝着他走来。擅做饭的闻家嫂嫂带来一筐吃食，林幺爹拾掇了鸡蛋，还有些乡亲拿着钉耙、挥着锄头——
一个个身影就像一滴滴水点儿，在原野上漫开。
陈途想，或许这就是桃源的源。
en:
At first, the folks back home couldn't wrap their heads around Chen Tu's return.
To them, he had gone through so much trouble just to pass the exams and get into Mohist City. Why on earth would he go through all that only to crawl right back to this poor, backward village?

"Tu, my boy, you worked so hard to get out of here. Have you lost your wits?" Old Uncle Lin was heartbroken. He was the one who had given Chen Tu three precious eggs to support his studies back in the day.
"Brother Tu, I heard Mohist City is a prosperous place. You really didn't want to stay?" asked Zhang Wa, pausing his plow with a look of deep regret.
Others were more hot-headed, swearing that if Chen Tu had been bullied in the city, they would risk their lives to teach those city folks a lesson.

None of their guesses were right, but the more he denied them, the more the rumors spread. Like bundles of firewood being fed into a stove, the gossip brought the normally quiet village to a rolling boil.
And the news that Chen Tu wanted to turn their village into "the Haven" was like dropping a massive boulder into that boiling pot, splashing scalding water everywhere.

"The Haven is supposed to be up in the heavens. How could a godforsaken place like ours ever be a Haven?"
"Tu, is your head feeling alright? Don't worry, your uncle will take you to see a doctor right now..."

Chen Tu truly had a headache now. It wasn't that he hadn't tried to explain, but the villagers didn't understand engineering, and words just weren't enough.
So he simply started working on his own. Taking out the irrigation blueprints his junior, Anshi, had once drawn for him, he began digging and moving dirt, step by step. Even if it felt as impossible as the mythical Jingwei bird trying to fill the ocean with pebbles, he kept at it.
Seeing this, the villagers only thought he had gone completely mad.

One day, two days, a month, two months. All by himself, with a single iron spade, Chen Tu barely managed to carve out one small channel.
But according to the blueprint, there were many more channels to dig. Rubbing his aching shoulders, he couldn't help but feel a flicker of despair at the sheer scale of the task.

"Move aside. You really are a city boy now." Suddenly, someone snatched the spade from his hands.
Chen Tu looked up to see Zhang Wa leaning casually against the handle.
"Which way?"
"Which way for what?"
"For that irrigation blueprint of yours. Which way do I dig?"

Chen Tu snapped back to reality and quickly pointed out a direction. He looked over and saw the rest of the village walking toward him. Madam Wen, the best cook in the village, had brought a basket of food. Old Uncle Lin had gathered some eggs. Other villagers were marching over, waving hoes and rakes.

One by one, their figures spread across the fields like droplets of water seeping into the thirsty earth.
Chen Tu thought to himself: perhaps this was the true source of the Haven.
Xiao Su Liu Yifei

zh:
黄沙漫天，行路多艰。你行走于玉门关外的无垠沙海之中。口干舌燥之际，你来到一处沙丘的阴凉之处，发现了一口枯井。这口井宽可容人。你还记得这里。你曾帮助马头村的挖井人取回井下的油灯。此刻，井中传来隐隐的水声与人声。你决定…… #Y【井下有水，自当痛饮。】
你小心地来到井下，惊喜地发现水已有没踝之深。你痛快地饮了个水饱。先人以血肉筑为地下水脉长城，那段史诗永远铭刻于沙海深处。#E你沿着水道来到一处临时搭建的落脚点。这里的人们向你自豪地讲述着马头村的过往，讲述着安西军饮马地的雄壮，讲述着几代挖井人的努力，还讲述了一位游侠的相助……你明知这是一场梦，但你仍相信，只要那盏油灯还在，井下就永远会清泉常涌，人的希望便永不枯竭。问渠哪得清如许，唯有万代执灯来。
en:
Yellow sand fills the sky, and the journey is arduous. You press on through the endless sea of dunes beyond Jade Gate Pass. Parched and faint with thirst, you come to the shaded side of a dune, where you find an old, dry well. The well is wide enough for a person to descend. You remember this place. Once, you helped the well-digger of Horsehelm Village recover an oil lamp from the depths below. At this moment, the faint murmur of water and human voices echoes from within the well. You decide to... #Y[Drink my fill.]
You carefully descend into the well and are delighted to find the water is already ankle-deep.
You heartily drink your fill. The ancestors built an underground Great Wall of water veins with arduous efforts, and that epic remains forever etched deep within the sea of sand.#E Following the underground watercourse, you come upon a makeshift refuge. The people here speak to you with pride of Horsehelm Village's past, of the might of the Anxi Army's watering grounds, of the generations of well-diggers' efforts, and of the help once given by a wanderer... You know this is only a dream, yet you still believe that as long as that oil lamp burns, clear spring water will forever flow beneath, and human hope will never run dry. "How does the water remain so clear? Only because, through countless generations, lamp-bearers will come."
